ai_citations_mentions_ai_citation.question: What is an AI citation?
ai_citations_mentions_ai_citation.answer: An AI citation is a source an AI assistant credits — usually as a link or footnote — when generating an answer. Being cited puts your brand in front of the user and often drives high-intent clicks.

ai_citations_mentions_unlinked_brand_men.question: Do unlinked brand mentions matter?
ai_citations_mentions_unlinked_brand_men.answer: Yes. Language models learn associations from text, so repeated unlinked mentions in trusted contexts still strengthen the connection between your brand and your category.

ai_citations_mentions_know_which_sources.question: How do you know which sources AI engines use?
ai_citations_mentions_know_which_sources.answer: We log the cited domains for every prompt in your tracking set. Those logs show, category by category, which publications and platforms actually influence the answers.

ai_citations_mentions_long_it_take.question: How long does it take to earn AI citations?
ai_citations_mentions_long_it_take.answer: Directory and review placements can register within weeks. Editorial roundup inclusion typically takes one to three months per placement depending on the publication's cycle.

ai_citations_mentions_this_same_as.question: Is this the same as link building?
ai_citations_mentions_this_same_as.answer: It overlaps, but the target list is different. Traditional link building chases authority metrics; citation building chases the specific sources engines quote, which are sometimes low-DA but highly cited.

ai_citations_mentions_get_us_onto.question: Can you get us onto review platforms like Clutch or G2?
ai_citations_mentions_get_us_onto.answer: We set up and optimise the profiles and run a compliant review request programme with your clients. We never write or buy reviews.

ai_citations_mentions_if_competitor_domi.question: What if a competitor dominates every roundup?
ai_citations_mentions_if_competitor_domi.answer: We target the gaps: newer publications, niche verticals, regional lists and comparison content of our own. Category incumbency is beatable with specificity.

ai_citations_mentions_measure_citation_g.question: How do you measure citation growth?
ai_citations_mentions_measure_citation_g.answer: Monthly citation rate across the tracked prompt set, the number of new citing domains, and referral traffic from assistants where analytics can identify it.

ai_citations_mentions_guest_posts_help.question: Do guest posts help AI visibility?
ai_citations_mentions_guest_posts_help.answer: Well-placed ones do, especially on sites assistants already cite. Low-quality mass guest posting does not, and can harm classic SEO at the same time.

ai_citations_mentions_much_citation_buil.question: How much does citation building cost?
ai_citations_mentions_much_citation_buil.answer: Guest posts start at $20 per placement, and digital PR campaigns are quoted per project after source mapping. Most clients run citation building inside a monthly AI SEO retainer.
